scope: Live TestProj browser-client patch review and native process build

provider.credential_source: Saved local xMind profile; secret omitted

changes: Added a visible focus outline for the model card.
Disabled the card transition when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
reviewed_edit.scope: One file; the xMind conversation showed the before/after proposal and reported no other source files changed.

process_profile_finding.error: The xlang3 process tried to open 'npm' as a source file.

live_xlang3_pytest_run.dependencies: Imported the existing project-local .xlang3-site packages, including pytest, FastAPI, Starlette and httpx.
live_xlang3_pytest_run.filesystem_verification: Backend entries retain their pre-test timestamps; -B disabled bytecode writes and pytest cache was disabled.

rendered_model_zoo_check.browser_surface: Codex in-app browser; external Chrome was unavailable
rendered_model_zoo_check.detail_result: Rendered the expected model title, metadata and illustrative-metrics disclosure

limitations: This verifies one reviewed frontend edit and a production build, not complete repository coding coverage or OpenCode parity.
The successful build used the configured PowerShell profile because npm is a Node tool; xlang3 remains the Python/runtime profile.
The build recreated TestProj dist artifacts. TestProj is not in the xMind repository and the workspace has no Git history for this acceptance.
Rendered application acceptance was performed in the Codex in-app browser because no external Chrome surface was available.
